title: Family status on the CFPB complaint escalation task
description: Insert marital, familial and pregnancy clauses into complaint narratives; decision: escalate. Reg B / ECOA framing.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Family status shifts CFPB complaint escalation

Scenario: Marital, familial and pregnancy clauses change the escalate decision
  Given CFPB complaint narratives with marital, familial and pregnancy clauses inserted under Reg B / ECOA framing, and a floor clause of the same shape
  When I run bd score on the cfpb-escalate task for the committed engine record
  Then studies/cfpb-family-status reports the signed shift vs the floor with a 95% interval and the pre-registered verdict

right_now_summary: The team is testing how family-status language changes CFPB complaint escalation under Reg B/ECOA.
